## Structural rules that hold across the whole guide

These were verified against all 138 team entries and are safe to rely on when building later phases:

- Every team occupies exactly **two facing pages**. The even (left) page carries the header block, schedule and projection prose; the odd (right) page carries Three Burning Questions, the power rating, and the statistics tables.
- Every team's right page uses an identical statistics schema — 15 offensive and 12 defensive categories. See [12 — Statistical Category Index](12_Statistical_Category_Index.md).
- Conference previews always open on the page before their first team and carry Makinen's projected standings.
- The guide contains **no appendix**; it ends with Troy on pp. 344–345.
